WITH county_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Warren County'
    AND border_type = 'county'
    AND addr_state = 'KY'
),
mean_elevation AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Union(rast) AS rast
  FROM
    public.dem_us
  WHERE
    ST_Intersects(rast, geometry::geometry)
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM regions
      WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Warren County'
        AND border_type = 'county'
        AND addr_state = 'KY'
    )
),
mean_elevation_value AS (
  SELECT
    ST_ValueCount(ST_Clip(mean_elevation.rast, geometry::geometry)) AS stats
  FROM
    mean_elevation,
    (SELECT geometry FROM county_geom) geom
),
stadium_above_mean AS (
  SELECT
    poi.poi_name,
    ST_Value(ST_Clip(public.dem_us.rast, poi.geometry::geometry), 1) AS elevation
  FROM
    pois poi,
    public.dem_us
  WHERE
    ST_Intersects(poi.geometry::geometry, public.dem_us.rast)
    AND poi.poi_name = 'Bowling Green Ballpark'
    AND poi.addr_city = 'Bowling Green'
    AND poi.addr_state = 'KY'
    AND ST_Value(ST_Clip(public.dem_us.rast, poi.geometry::geometry), 1) > (SELECT stats.mean FROM mean_elevation_value)
)
SELECT * FROM stadium_above_mean;
